scoring_justification: The activation energy is recomputed from raw temperature-TOF data; kinetic orders are recomputed from pressure-TOF data. No trust in self-reported numbers.

hidden_assets.purpose: Target ranges for activation energy and kinetic orders
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct copy from paper: Ea 9–12 kcal/mol, H2 order 0.65–0.85, C2H4 order –0.4 to 0.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Exact numbers stated in the paper's conclusions and figure descriptions.

outputs.description: Raw TOF vs temperature data; the checker will recompute the apparent activation energy from these points.

schema.description: A single floating-point number representing the fitted activation energy in kcal/mol.

outputs.description: The agent-reported activation energy; used as a reference, with primary scoring via recomputation from arrhenius_tof.csv.
TOF data at varying H₂ and C₂H₄ pressures; the checker will recompute the kinetic orders from these points.

output_contract.notes: The verifier will check activation energy and kinetic orders against acceptable ranges; the exact ranges are not disclosed to the agent.

steps.description: File contains six rows, TOF values positive and decreasing with increasing temperature.
Fit ln(TOF) vs 1/T; derive activation energy in kcal/mol; must be within 9-12 kcal/mol.
Self-reported activation energy must match the recomputed Ea from arrhenius_tof.csv within ±2 kcal/mol.
From H2 variation rows, fit log TOF vs log P_H2; order must be within 0.65–0.85.
From C2H4 variation rows, fit log TOF vs log P_C2H4; order must be within -0.4 to 0.
